# Compilatio

> > Compilatio is a comprehensive plagiarism and AI detection platform for educators, students, and professionals, offering specialized tools for academic integrity and responsible AI usage.

Compilatio provides plagiarism detection, AI-generated content identification, and text alteration detection across multiple languages. The platform integrates with major learning management systems and offers institutional support, training, and communication tools for anti-plagiarism strategies in educational and professional contexts.

## Key Topics

- Plagiarism Detection
- AI Detection
- Academic Integrity
- Compilatio Magister

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Compilatio Homepage](https://www.compilatio.net): Compilatio homepage: plagiarism and AI detection for teachers, students, writers
- [Compilatio Magister](https://www.compilatio.net/magister): Compilatio Magister: plagiarism detector for teachers, universities, and schools
- [Compilatio Magister+](https://www.compilatio.net/magister-plus): Compilatio Magister+: plagiarism and AI detection tool for teachers with paraphrase detection
- [Compilatio Studium](https://www.compilatio.net/studium): Compilatio Studium: plagiarism and AI detector for student theses and reports
- [Compilatio 1D345 Copyright](https://www.compilatio.net/copyright): Compilatio 1D345 Copyright: plagiarism checker for professional writers and publishers
- [Infoplag Communication Tool](https://www.compilatio.net/infoplag): Infoplag: dedicated website tool for institutional anti-plagiarism communication

## Education & Institutional Solutions

- [Solutions for Teachers & Universities](https://www.compilatio.net/education-enseignants): Compilatio Magister/Magister+ plagiarism detection for teachers and universities
- [Anti-plagiarism Strategy & Implementation](https://www.compilatio.net/demarche): Compilatio anti-plagiarism strategy with annual support and pedagogical resources
- [LMS Integration](https://www.compilatio.net/lms-integration): Compilatio integration with Moodle, Canvas, Brightspace, Teams, BlackBoard LMS
- [Expert Consulting & Custom Support](https://www.compilatio.net/accompagnement-expert): Expert consulting and custom support for institutional anti-plagiarism strategies

## Technology & Detection Methods

- [Similarity Detection Technology](https://www.compilatio.net/detection-similitudes): Similarity detection technology explanation: Compilatio's plagiarism detection method
- [AI Content Detection](https://www.compilatio.net/ia-detecteur-info): French AI detector for ChatGPT, Mistral, Gemini, Claude, and other AI-generated text
- [Text Alteration Detection](https://www.compilatio.net/detection-alteration-info): Text alteration detection: identifying disguised plagiarism and hidden AI content
